summary.text: Scott Madon is a Republican member of the Kentucky Senate representing District 29, serving since 2025. The legislature's profile lists Madon as co-chair of the Budget Review Subcommittee on General Government, Finance & Public Protection.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Scott Madon works in insurance with Assured Partners and attended Eastern Kentucky University.
The profile lists his service as mayor of Pineville from 2015 to 2025 and as chair of the Cumberland Valley Area Development District.
